reports_page_description: PDF with income, expenses, balance and houses with pending fees.
reports_month_description: From the 1st to the last day of the month.
reports_range_description: Choose the first and last day of the report.
reports_no_dates_description: The report covers each period's days up to today, and no period has started. Create one in {#b}Presidency{/b}.
reports_download_failed: Couldn't generate the report. Reload the page and try again.
reports_contents_description: With the community's logo and name, ready to share with the residents.
reports_contents_summary_description: Opening balance, income, expenses and closing balance for the chosen dates.
reports_contents_income_description: What came in, with each category's total and number of transactions.
reports_contents_expense_description: What went out, with each category's total and number of transactions.
reports_contents_fees_description: How many houses are up to date, which months each of the others owes, and which paid in advance.
reports_include_advance_description: Adds the houses that already paid fees for future months to {#b}Maintenance fees{/b}. Applies to both reports.
reports_sign_in_required: Sign in to download the report
reports_range_end_before_start: The end date must be on or after the start date
reports_pdf_balance_note: Opening balance: everything recorded before {date}. Closing balance = opening balance + income - expenses.
reports_pdf_all_up_to_date: All houses are up to date.
reports_pdf_no_fees: No fees due in this date range.
reports_pdf_advance_hint: Houses that already paid fees for future months. That money only shows in the income of the month it was received.
reports_pdf_dates_note: This report only includes money that came in or went out from {from} to {to}, by the date of each transaction. A fee counts as paid if its payment was recorded on or before {to}.
